title: Nodduɗo Goonga mo Diwtataa
intro: Nelaaɗo ina darii tan e nder leñol tiiɗngol, ina nodda ɓe feewde e Alla gooto Goonga oo, tawi ɓe ngoni ko e jokkondirde e sanamuuji fenaande. Oo annabaajo ina jogii innde nde ina nanndi e maanaa baawɗo wonde fof – ‘’ƴettuɗo ndeenka’’ – kono ina heɓa tan ko jaɓde e yeddude. E nder muñal leefngal e jeertinaango tiiɗngo, ooɗoo ruuhu ina jogii nulal diine ngal winndere ndee e hoore mum maa seertu e joofnirde. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo ɗoo limre tiiɗnde, lomtotoonde gooto e daartol ɓurngol ɓooyde e nder defte lislaam?
clues: Leñol am ina rewa laamɓe heewɓe, miɗo nodda ɓe ngam gollanaade tagɗo asamaan e leydi.
Mi darii yeeso leñol am, mi wi’i hay njoɓdi wootere mi ɗaɓɓataa e maɓɓe – yiɗde am tan ko ardude e maɓɓe e peewal.
Henndu mawndu neldaama e dow leñol am ko jukkungo Alla, henndu ndu Quraan haali e mum e nder keewal e nder rewɓe.
Mi wonaa no won e annabaaɓe nii, mi rokkaaka debbo walla sukaaɓe ciftorteeɓe no feewi e nder daartol am, sabu golle am ko noddude leñol am tan.
Innde am ina jogii maanaa luggiɗɗo—ina jokkondiri e miijo ndeenka e reentaade mo neɗɗo yiɗi.
Yimɓe am ina nganndiranoo helmere geɗel gootel keertiingel wonande falnde nde ɓe ngoni ndee, leydi maɓɓe ina siforee e majjere teeŋtunde sabu ŋakkeende leɗɗe.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Hay gooto e leñol am daɗaani e jukkungo ngo
Mi ƴettaa ko e nguurndam no miñi am Yunus nii
Mi eggii e almuɓɓe am leydi barkinndi
Henndu nduu halki ko heeferɓe tan tawi gooŋɗinɓe ina nguuri
outcome.answer: Hay gooto e leñol am daɗaani e jukkungo ngo

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning. (54:18)
